::: {#def-acceptance-ratio}
#### Acceptance ratio

For a target posterior $\p(\vth \mid \vy) \propto \p(\vy \mid \vth)\, \p(\vth)$,
a [proposal distribution](#def-proposal-distribution) $q$,
a current value $\vth^{(t)}$, and a candidate $\vth^*$,
the **acceptance ratio** is

$$
\alpha \eqdef
\frac{\p(\vy \mid \vth^*)\, \p(\vth^*)}{\p(\vy \mid \vth^{(t)})\, \p(\vth^{(t)})}
\cdot
\frac{q(\vth^{(t)} \mid \vth^*)}{q(\vth^* \mid \vth^{(t)})}.
$$

:::
